szenen.text: Anthropic's stock is back at its IPO price. In just two days.
Thursday, day one: IPO price eighty-three dollars. The first trade: one hundred eleven fifty. Valued at one point seven six trillion dollars.
Friday, day two: down about fourteen percent, to eighty-three dollars and ten cents. Just ten cents above the IPO price.

foto.unter: SEC probe into Nvidia, same day

szenen.text: Why? The same day, the SEC opened a probe into Nvidia's accounting, and investors dumped AI stocks.
Our view: when the hottest IPO of the year can't hold for two days, the AI hype is running out of buyers.
